newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Oct fiscal deficit $441.6 mln - official.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Oct fiscal deficit $441.6 mln - official.

text.p: Argentina posted a $441.6 million fiscal deficit before privatizations in October, down from a $509.1 million shortfall in September, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.
Total revenues were $3.84 billion and total expenditures $4.03 billion.
Including income from privatizations, the deficit was $441.1 million.
In the January-October period, the fiscal shortfall before privatizations was $4.5 billion. Argentina has agreed with the International Monetary Fund on a $6.0 billion fiscal deficit for 1996.
